definition.//: A bounded queue length. An unbounded queue hides a dead consumer until the broker runs out of disk; rejecting publishes makes the failure visible immediately.
Dead-lettered messages are evidence and are never expired automatically. In a financial system, discarding the record of a failed event is worse than a full queue.
